title: Dismissed Laguna town mayor to appeal Ombudsman ruling over Christmas party solicitation

blocks.text: Dismissed Luisiana, Laguna Mayor Jomapher Uy Alvarez said he would appeal the Ombudsman’s decision removing him from office after finding him liable for grave misconduct over the solicitation of P11,000 for a municipal employees’ Christmas party.
